title: WEF ECP Fall 2026 requisition graph — depth 1
summary: Official pages show two umbrella cohort requisitions and at least four later centre/team-specific requisitions.

data.question: What public requisition structure may explain split Workday entries?
data.method: Compare official WEF Workday postings with bounded public applicant observations.
data.framework: Requisition chronology with applicant-level inference explicitly limited.
data.scope: WEF ECP Fall 2026 public postings and the captured Reddit thread.
findings: R4071 covers Geneva, Mumbai, Tokyo and Beijing.
R4072 covers New York and San Francisco.
Both umbrella pages publish the same multi-stage selection sequence.
R4203, R4211, R4214 and R4218 are later role-specific postings.
Reddit users reported separate entries, divergent statuses and temporary team assignment visibility.
conclusions: The evidence supports umbrella intake followed by role-specific requisitions.
Team-specific routing is plausible but not publicly confirmed.
A separate entry does not prove advancement, transfer or rejection.
recommendations: Track office, centre, team, function, themes and dates.
Do not assign fixed meanings to undocumented Workday status labels.
counterarguments: Role postings may be independent searches.
Separate records may be administrative duplicates.
limitations: WEF does not define the portal labels publicly.

workflow.next_action: Enumerate the complete Fall 2026 requisition inventory.
